paper_title: Let the Expert Stick to His Last Expert-Specialized Fine-Tuning for   Sparse Architectural Large Language Models
caption: Top Expert distribution for specific tasks. Shaded areas represent variance across layers. The figure shows that few experts handle most gate values, highlighting expert specialization for different tasks.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the normalized average gate value across a range of experts for different tasks, with each task represented by a distinct line. The x-axis is labeled "Experts" and uses a exponential scale, ranging from 1 to 64. The tick labels are positioned at intervals: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, and 64. The y-axis is labeled "Normalized Average Gate Value", employs a linear scale, and ranges from 0.00 to 0.20, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. There are six colored lines representing different tasks and one dashed line illustrating a uniform reference. The "Intent" line is orange with no markers and maintains a relatively consistent, low value starting from approximately 0.05, slowly decreasing toward the x-axis. The "Summary" task is shown in blue, beginning around 0.07 and gently declining. The "Law" line is yellow, starting a bit above 0.06 and shows a gradual decrease. The "Translation" line is purple and starts around 0.17, sharply decreasing before leveling off near the x-axis. The "Math" line is gray, beginning near 0.05 and steadily decreasing. The "Code" line is light green, starting slightly above 0.06 and decreasing steadily. The "Uniform" line is black, dashed, and remains constant across all values of the x-axis at a normalized average gate value close to 0.01. All lines have variance, shaded in light color. All the lines converges at the end near 64. A legend is given top right.
